question: How does Daytona view the CLI versus MCP debate?
content: The episode explores the tension between command-line interfaces and newer agent protocols.
description: What is Daytona's position on CLI versus MCP for agent tooling?
options: They believe CLI is the appropriate interface for agents because it is universal and well-understood
They are building their own proprietary protocol to replace both CLI and MCP

description: What is Daytona's view on the business model of reselling LLM tokens to customers?
options: Token resale has almost no margin and is a losing business model long-term
